snippet.title: SELINI - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
A wordless journey of foggy wastelands, abandoned machinery and robot kinship. Explore and uncover meaning without guidance or dialogue. Dive into a nonlinear exploration adventure filled with corrupted replicants, robot uprising, brutal warmachines and more. Guide a lone replicant from a war-torn metropolis through dunes, forest and sea as you unveil the secrets of this cryptic world.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1434050/SELINI/
